title: Coordinate truth table representation
statement: For every natural number $n$ and coordinate $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the sign vector that is $-1$ precisely at indices encoding Boolean strings whose $j$th bit is true, and $1$ elsewhere, equals the truth table of the $j$th coordinate, with true encoded by $-1$ and false by $1$.
